description: This file implements a compatibility layer mapping numpy-like functions and signatures to PyTorch operations, facilitating code compatibility and easing development. It contains numerous functions for array manipulation, linear algebra, statistical operations, and array creation, primarily wrapping or reimplementing numpy functions using torch as the backend.

ctags.name: _concatenate
ctags.signature: ( tensors, axis=0, out=None, dtype=None, casting: Optional[CastingModes] = "same_kind" )

ctags.name: allclose
ctags.pattern: /^def allclose(a: ArrayLike, b: ArrayLike, rtol=1e-05, atol=1e-08, equal_nan=False):$/
ctags.signature: (a: ArrayLike, b: ArrayLike, rtol=1e-05, atol=1e-08, equal_nan=False)

ctags.name: arange
ctags.signature: ( start: Optional[ArrayLikeOrScalar] = None, stop: Optional[ArrayLikeOrScalar] = None, step: Optional[ArrayLikeOrScalar] = 1, dtype: Optional[DTypeLike] = None, *, like: NotImplementedType = None, )

ctags.name: argsort
ctags.pattern: /^def argsort(a: ArrayLike, axis=-1, kind=None, order: NotImplementedType = None):$/
ctags.signature: (a: ArrayLike, axis=-1, kind=None, order: NotImplementedType = None)

ctags.name: bincount
ctags.pattern: /^def bincount(x: ArrayLike, \/, weights: Optional[ArrayLike] = None, minlength=0):$/

ctags.name: broadcast_to
ctags.pattern: /^def broadcast_to(array: ArrayLike, shape, subok: NotImplementedType = False):$/

ctags.name: choose
ctags.signature: ( a: ArrayLike, choices: Sequence[ArrayLike], out: Optional[OutArray] = None, mode: NotImplementedType = "raise", )

ctags.name: clip
ctags.signature: ( a: ArrayLike, min: Optional[ArrayLike] = None, max: Optional[ArrayLike] = None, out: Optional[OutArray] = None, )

ctags.name: column_stack
ctags.signature: ( tup: Sequence[ArrayLike], *, dtype: Optional[DTypeLike] = None, casting: Optional[CastingModes] = "same_kind", )

ctags.name: concatenate

ctags.signature: ( a: ArrayLike, order: NotImplementedType = "K", subok: NotImplementedType = False )

ctags.name: copyto
ctags.signature: ( dst: NDArray, src: ArrayLike, casting: Optional[CastingModes] = "same_kind", where: NotImplementedType = None, )

ctags.pattern: /^def cross(a: ArrayLike, b: ArrayLike, axisa=-1, axisb=-1, axisc=-1, axis=None):$/

ctags.signature: ( a: ArrayLike, n=1, axis=-1, prepend: Optional[ArrayLike] = None, append: Optional[ArrayLike] = None, )

ctags.signature: ( tup: Sequence[ArrayLike], *, dtype: Optional[DTypeLike] = None, casting: Optional[CastingModes] = "same_kind", )
